title: Agent manifest (SPEC/00 section 6; M01 scope, SPEC/01 section 10 and feasibility.md section 2.6)

name.description: The agent's name. The bundle is agents/<name>/ and the runtime is named for it.

version.description: Tool Owner (M02 PR 2): the contract's version, major.minor.patch. validate computes the bump the diff needs (an edge or tool-schema change is major, R7) and fails a smaller assertion. Absent means 1.0.0.

model.description: Threshold Owner: the agent model id + version + region (SPEC/00 section 5). A-vs-A compares the pair at M04.

version.description: null until Bedrock returns a version for the profile (ruling G, re-ruled at M01 PR 2 with the cap).

judge_model_id.description: Threshold Owner. null until the judge is picked at M03 (R6).

guardrail.description: Rule Owner: the guardrail id and version. null until M03.

version.description: A numbered version, never DRAFT (rule-owner F4, M03 PR 1).

endpoint_allowlist.description: Security (ruling d, amended at M01 PR 3 to add ecr.api and ecr.dkr): AWS service names only at M01, one VPC endpoint each. The agent's security group egress allows these and nothing else; a hostname outside the enum is refused at synth. Arbitrary hostnames are M05.

seats.description: Security: seat -> GitHub login (SPEC/00 R1, amended at M06 PR 1). validate refuses a seat that is null or not a login with access to the repository (src/validate/seats.py, M06 PR 2).

may_call.description: Tool Owner: the edges this agent may call, each <agent>@<major>. Both sides declare an edge (M02). Empty at M01: ratings-helper is cut to M02.

may_be_called_by.description: Tool Owner: the agents that may call this one. Same shape as may_call.

ceilings.description: Tool Owner: concurrency, per-edge rps, depth 2, fan-out 3 (SPEC/00 section 6). Read by validate from M02, when an edge exists.

daily_usd.description: Threshold Owner. The eval role's budget is separate and is Security's (ruling a).

memory.description: Retention, ttl, per_user. null at M01: no memory is wired.

data_class.description: Informational in the PoC; enforcement is deferred (SPEC/00 section 12).

rollout.description: all-at-once, or retired (M07 PR 2; SPEC/07 section 1, BLOCK 1). A retirement arrives as a pull request from the platform that sets this to retired; at a head the platform's App passed, the deploy path then removes the agent's runtime and deploys nothing. One-way: nothing restores the runtime's ARN.

platform_version.description: The platform tag or commit the template was made from (SPEC/00 section 6, amended at M07 PR 1): a milestone tag when the commit carries one, else the short commit (scripts/make_template.py, from M07 PR 2). An agent is behind when the commit this names is an ancestor of the template's and not equal to it.

pinned_roles.description: Threshold Owner: every other role's pinned id (baseline, swaps, deprecation plant, judge candidates), moved here from milestones/M00/README.md at M01 PR 1. Read by the milestone that names each role.
